commits.message:
Lower persistent cURL connection sharing floor to 8.12.0 (#3701)

* Lower persistent cURL connection sharing floor to 8.12.0

The 8.20.0 floor was set for proxy-credential reuse fixes that Guzzle already sections independently. 8.12.0 is the lowest libcurl at which every connection-reuse defect reachable by a default https:// request is fixed (CVE-2024-0853, 8.6.0) and the shared TLS session cache resumes reliably across handles (curl #16245). The SSL_SESSION and proxy-credential floors are unchanged; mTLS client-certificate users below 8.21.0 (CVE-2026-8932) are documented as a caveat pending the follow-up direct-TLS sectioning.

* Document mTLS reuse risk and proxy-throw nuance for the 8.12.0 floor

Responds to review of the lowered persistent connection-sharing floor. Documents the mTLS connection-reuse gap (CVE-2026-8932) as an accepted opt-in risk on libcurl 8.12.0-8.20.x rather than mitigating it in code. Corrects the stale 'PERSISTENT_REQUIRE exists only on >= 8.20.0' statement and documents the now-reachable, intended PERSISTENT_REQUIRE throw for Basic/Digest proxy credentials (and a literal Proxy-Authorization header) on 8.12.0-8.19.x. Clarifies that proxy-auth safety under a configured share handle is force-fresh/rejection, not signature sectioning. Adds a contributor-reference subsection on the direct-mTLS accepted risk, and a test pinning the proxy-credential PERSISTENT_REQUIRE boundary at 8.12.0-8.19.x vs 8.20.0.

* Wrap transport-sharing docs at 80 columns
